as_told.title: Hoover personally vetting Propheta's priests and bishops

plain: In the Bronx in New York, a man called Propheta led a small church called the American Orthodox Catholic Church. Around 1965, he began demanding that other churches submit to FBI background checks to prove they were acceptable to him. The author Peter Levenda tells Michels this, and in a second telling adds, from what he was told, that Propheta's own priests and bishops "were vetted by J. Edgar Hoover himself," dating that to 1968 or 1969. If true, the FBI was tied closely to this tiny church.
